name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated response aligns with the context and topic of the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency of the generated response in relation to the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Determines how interesting and engaging the generated response is for the conversation partner.

name: Informativeness
description: Measures the amount of relevant and useful information provided in the generated response.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and inventiveness of the generated response, given the context.

name: Appropriateness
description: Evaluates the suitability of the generated response in terms of language, tone, and style, based on the conversation context.
